name: Chicken-Rice "Paella" Bake with Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Artichoke
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Place both in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper and asparagus; set aside.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet with juices for later use.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and rice; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 2 minutes.

Once the veggies are soft, add broth, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the skillet and nestle into the veggies and rice; cover the skillet with an ovenproof lid or aluminum foil.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until rice has fully absorbed liquid and chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chicken and rice are done, add artichokes and half of the parsley to the skillet; stir to combine the "paella." (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide paella between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
